title: Reception and eSIM Connectivity
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on weak radio or mobile reception and comments about how eSIM connectivity may be affected by signal conditions.

negative.summary: The negative feedback describes poor radio reception with frequent dropped VHF stations.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined comments mention lack of mobile reception at home and note that weak cellular signal may affect the eSIM, while one fragment says the car antenna should improve reception compared with a phone.

limitations: The sample is very small, with only one clearly negative review and two undetermined comments.
The undetermined examples mix home mobile coverage, eSIM behavior, and radio reception, so the topic is not fully coherent across fragments.
Several fragments describe circumstances or explanations without a clear vehicle sentiment, which limits firmer conclusions.
